evals.prompt: Create a new user story issue on GitHub for adding dark mode toggle using the gh CLI with acceptance criteria and labels.
evals.expected_output: A gh issue create CLI invocation containing title, body with user story and checkbox criteria, and label flag.
assertions: Uses gh issue create CLI command
Sets title clearly prefixed or labeled as a user story
Includes body with As a / I want / So that user story structure
Includes verifiable acceptance criteria formatted as markdown checkboxes

evals.prompt: Close GitHub issue #42 after completing work, adding a closing comment confirming verification.
evals.expected_output: A gh issue close CLI call specifying issue number 42 with a descriptive --comment flag.
assertions: Uses gh issue close 42 CLI command
Includes an explanatory verification comment via --comment flag
Confirms that acceptance criteria were satisfied
